examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Color, Background Color, and Opacity
examples.description: This example demonstrates the basic usage of the QRCode component. It sets the QR code color using the color attribute, the background color using the backgroundColor attribute, and the opacity using the contentOpacity attribute.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Background Color to Transparent
examples.description: This example shows how to set the QR code background color to transparent using the backgroundColor attribute, allowing the QR code content to blend with the background.
